hypotheses.reasoning: session-cache restarted empty after node replacement (no RDB snapshot); miss ratio jumped to 95% and account-svc fell through to accounts-db, saturating connections/CPU and producing 7-9s queries, causing login timeouts/504s at edge-proxy. Cache stampede amplification.
Slow accounts-db queries could be read as dependency timeout, but they follow the cache wipe and load spike.
DB connection limit near capacity, but driven by stampede not normal load.

verdict.recommendedAction: Stop the stampede on accounts-db: rate-limit or coalesce cache-miss loads in account-svc (single-flight), warm session-cache, and temporarily raise DB capacity. Enable RDB/AOF persistence or replica failover for session-cache so node replacement doesn't start it empty.
